notes.title: Mini-Devlog #2: Scoring Mechanics
notes.notes: [p]Hey, everyone![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43159211/fce5970f6d1375e758b702fac187ae37a03b1fec.png"][/img][/p][p]Scoring is an integral part of any arcade-style game, and it plays an important part in the long-term enjoyment of BIRDCAGE as well. Today we'd like to share some high-level information about the Scoring systems in our game.[/p][p][/p][h3]ENEMY DESTRUCTION[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43159211/767ac6170605d81d976d29c32df39e610e7b34d2.png"][/img][/p][p]As you might expect, destroying enemies will add to your SCORE. Simple, classic, elegant. Timeless.[/p][p][/p][h3]CHAINING[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43159211/8910f6911a23ea5a4161e61bd3f61962ed689009.png"][/img][/p][p]Enemies destroyed are tallied up in the CHAIN Counter, which must be maintained and increased by shooting and destroying enemies. The value of the current CHAIN acts as a multiplier to all awarded score points. Keep the pressure on! But beware -- taking damage will drop the CHAIN Counter back to zero![/p][p][/p][h3]HYPER BULLET CANCELING[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43159211/1000d7941e16dd58b2b3d99efafb4ae1f7651847.png"][/img][/p][p]When in HYPER Mode, enemy bullets will be canceled and turned into Small Medals, which can be collected to increase your SCORE. Trigger HYPER Mode strategically to maximize your scoring![/p][p][/p][h3]PB MEDALS[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43159211/0ef874bba6e8c7f2e588c23661d4964ee987cc06.png"][/img][/p][p]There are three PB Medals hidden in every stage for you to collect and dramatically increase your SCORE -- and remember, the CHAIN Counter will multiply the value of these Medals as well. Finding all PB Medals will also award bonus points on clearing a stage, so track them all down![/p][p][/p][h3]THE SWORD[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43159211/2f91916c5c7bf57a310e5bff936e35068bf172a1.png"][/img][/p][p]Early on in the development of BIRDCAGE, we realized the game would focus heavily on the SWORD -- it was fun and impactful to use for survival, but we also wanted to find ways to incentivize its use through the game's scoring mechanics.[/p][p]And so, the SWORD became the backbone of high-level play in BIRDCAGE. Destroying enemies using the SWORD will greatly increase the value of the score points they'll award, additionally dropping extra Small Medals for you to collect. The SWORD can also absorb Blue bullets, aiding survival and adding to your SCORE.[/p][p][/p][h3]...AND MORE![/h3][p]These are only the main pillars of Scoring in BIRDCAGE -- there are more score-increasing systems to take advantage of, all tied to your performance and skilled play.[/p][p][/p][p]We'll let your discover the rest for yourself when BIRDCAGE launches later this year![/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for reading![/p][p]-Giannis and Barry[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43159211/87056d1cb96379e98332473904d1135a6ba7fdc7.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Mini-Devlog #1: Difficulty Modes
notes.notes:
Hey, everyone!

We'd like to start sharing more about the development of BIRDCAGE here, and thought we could start with what we've been spending time on recently: fine-tuning the game to be enjoyable for players of all skill levels.

Here's an example of the differences between Easy and Hard mode, showcased by our dear friend -EXALT-, the mid-boss of Stage 3.

[previewyoutube=2cKhhb70UVE;full][/previewyoutube]
[i]Thank you for your sacrifice, -EXALT-.[/i]

Our goal with Easy Mode is to help ease in players who might be unfamiliar with shoot-'em-ups but still want to see what BIRDCAGE has to offer, in terms of gameplay, story, and surprises.

Accordingly, we want to accommodate the core shmup audience and their built-in, legacy skills, hoping to provide a more hectic and challenging playthrough with Hard Mode.

We're trying to achieve all this by going in and hand-picking which patterns to adjust, along with other gameplay modifications, such as the AUTO-HYPER in Easy Mode, and increased bullet speed (and score multipliers!) in Hard Mode -- all hoping to provide different tunings of the game that still feel meaningful and fun.

Thanks for reading!

-Giannis and Barry
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43159211/87056d1cb96379e98332473904d1135a6ba7fdc7.png[/img]

notes.title: Happy Holidays!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43159211/5036adaed02ae2c04a47e2fd3ba06fb881ce58b5.jpg[/img]
Hello, everyone!
We wanted to share a quick message with you as 2024 winds down.

Work on BIRDCAGE has been progressing at a steady pace and we're pleased to say we've been meeting our internal milestones for the game's development.
The game is now fully playable and we're in the final stretch of getting everything in place, tested and lined up for the future.

We hope to have more news to share soon.
Thank you for your patience and continued interest!

Happy Holidays from POLYGON BIRD! We wish you the very best for 2025.

-Giannis and Barry

notes.title: Bugfixes and Demo Availability Extension
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, and thanks for checking out the [i]BIRDCAGE -Halcyon Prototype Module-[/i] demo!

We've just updated the game, fixing a few small bugs and tightening up the experience.
The main updates include:
[list]
[*]Fixed a game crashing bug when destroying the enemies in the tutorial using the Sword.
[*]Improved loading at the beginning of stages.
[*]Corrected an issue with the boss destruction sequence.
[/list]
[b]Please note:[/b] The demo for BIRDCAGE will remain available to play for another week, until [b]October 11th 2023[/b].

Thank you again for your feedback, support, and for playing BIRDCAGE!
Best,
